propositions: restore_deleted_sources enumerates deletions with a directory-scoped pathspec walk that misses events due to git path history simplification, causing permanent SNAPSHOT_MISSING_SOURCES findings
git log --diff-filter=D with a per-directory pathspec fails to find deletions that a per-uuid glob pathspec discovers, indicating the root cause is pathspec scope not merge-commit visibility
restore_deleted_sources needs a per-uuid glob fallback bounded to uuids still absent after the cheap directory pass to recover unrecoverable sources
the fallback must preserve newest-deletion-wins semantics by streaming and taking the first hit, matching _deleted_history behavior

the restore cluster (_deleted_history, _deleted_path_for_uuid, _uuid_fallback, restore_deleted_sources, rebuild_with_restore) moves from fsck_repair to new fsck_restore module to stay within module-size constraints
